subject: Decision criteria clarification: latency, cost, deployment & SLA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finova.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & clarification: decision criteria

Tom — great to meet you and the Finova team earlier. Quick recap from our call and a couple of clarifying questions so we can align next steps.

Recap:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + doc summarization for regulated products.
- Expected steady-state: ~5M tokens/month; bursty spikes during payroll windows (~3x).
- Important decision criteria: latency targets for live chat, unit cost per 1k tokens, deployment mode (hosted vs private VPC), and SLA/backfill for downtime.

Questions (to help us size proposals):
1) Latency: for live chat, are you targeting p90 < 300ms for short responses (~50 tokens) or is p95/p99 more critical?
2) Cost: is there a target blended cost per 1k tokens (or monthly spend range) the finance team expects?
3) Deployment: is Private (VPC) required for go-live, or would you consider Redwood Dedicated initially and migrate later?
4) Procurement: who is the economic buyer and who will own security/compliance reviews (SOC2, data residency)?

I've attached a short recap PDF and will put together two configurations (hosted + private) once we have the answers. Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up next week to align on procurement timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-9182

Attachment: 2027-08-20-redwood-decision-criteria-recap.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finova.com>, Kevin Morales <kevin.morales@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & clarification: decision criteria

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Short answers below to help you size.

1) Latency: p90 < 350ms is our internal target for chat; p99 is nice to know but not a blocker at first. For longer generative replies (200+ tokens) we expect up to 1s.
2) Cost: finance prefers to see a plan < $12k/month initially for proof-of-value, with ability to scale. They care about predictable committed spend.
3) Deployment: security strongly prefers Private (VPC) for any PHI/PII workloads, but we can pilot on Dedicated if we isolate data. We'd need to understand encryption/KMS options.
4) Procurement: Economic buyer is Priya (cc'd). Security/legal requests typically come through Kevin (cc'd).

We can do a follow-up Wed or Thu next week.

Thanks —
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
Tom.Reynolds@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finova.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finova.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & clarification: decision criteria

Priya & Team — thanks for confirming, and welcome Priya. A few quick clarifications so we present the right procurement package to your finance and security teams: 

- Latency: we'll size two performance profiles: (A) low-latency profile tuned for p90<350ms for short replies, (B) throughput-optimized profile for batch jobs. We'll include benchmarked p95/p99 numbers for each.
- Cost: we'll provide a proof-of-value configuration that targets ~ $10k/month blended cost for the first 30 days and a forecasted scale plan. If Finance needs a committed contract, we can show Dedicated reserved pricing vs hosted.
- Deployment & Security: Redwood Private (VPC) supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs. We'll attach a SOC2 summary and a short runbook describing encryption, network flows, and SIEM integration points.
- Procurement steps: for proposals that require contract/legal review, who on your side handles initial PO/terms? (Tom, is Kevin the right contact or should we loop Legal?)

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thu 26 Aug 09:00 PT or Fri 27 Aug 10:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot and I'll send a calendar invite and a short one-pager for your procurement team.

Best —
Marissa
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finova.com>, Kevin Morales <kevin.morales@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 08:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & clarification: decision criteria

Marissa — thanks, that plan makes sense. Quick answers:
- Procurement: I own the economic decision for this proof-of-value. For contract/legal terms we'll involve our Legal counsel (CC: Kevin) — Kevin will lead SOC2 and contract redlines.
- Timeline: we can run a 30-day proof-of-value (POV) starting mid-Sept. For the POV we prefer Private (VPC) but will accept Dedicated if setup time is an issue; security acceptance criteria must be met before move to production.
- Contract: for POV we'll need a short PO and an MSA with a SOC2 appendix. Can you provide a sample PO language and the MSA template?

Confirming Thu 26th doesn't work for us (calendar conflict) — Thu 2 Sept 09:00 PT works for the exec-level scoping call. For the procurement kick-off, can you propose an owner on your side for contract coordination?

Thanks —
Priya Singh
VP, Finance & Operations | Finova

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finova.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finova.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & clarification: decision criteria

Priya — perfect, thanks for the clarity and the timeline. Next steps from Redwood: 
1) I'll share a short MSA + SOC2 appendix and sample PO language by EOD tomorrow.
2) Rachel (cc'd) will be your Redwood contract owner for PO/MSA coordination. Rachel will join the 2 Sept scoping call.
3) We'll deliver two configuration options (Private VPC and Dedicated) and a 30-day POV plan targeting ~$10k for the first month.

Would you like us to include an option for an accelerated setup (paid setup) so we can guarantee a mid-Sept start? If yes, we can include estimated setup time and cost in the proposal.

Calendar: I'll send the 2 Sept invite and attach the docs.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: 2027-08-30-redwood-msa-sample.pdf
